reported_symptom: Pan or zoom trails behind input.
conclusion: Reviewed source fixes reduce repeated work, but large overviews still miss the interactive frame budget. Native end-to-end improvement and 60 fps are not established.

source.note: The workflow source changes CI only relative to the product source. This report is a documentation-only followup and does not change the measured product code.

fixes.change: Avoid authored-path hashing when ordinary brush strokes have no cached agent preview.
Conservatively reject distant stroke picks before exact outline construction, preserving candidate boundary checks.
Decode disk posters through shared bounded preview workers; handle stale tabs, cancellation and fresh captures.
Reuse resident source/camera/aspect poster identities, bound bulk mesh parsing, and allow at most one actual GPU poster attempt per frame.

Protect current/previous paint epochs and bound eviction scanning to one frame-start sweep, retaining a warm subset within the existing memory and entry limits. Misses always build and paint immediately.

validation.ignored_cpu_probes: Exact 750-path cache and generated mixed navigation tests executed separately and passed execution/invariant checks. The mixed benchmark has no frame-budget assertion.

preserved_prior_failure.diagnostic: Windows shell refused deletion with 0x7c. Focused diagnostic passed; the later integrated full suite also passed this unchanged test. The original integrated failure remains part of the evidence.

pen_cache.coverage: All 750 overview paths request and convert each frame. Retention bypass does not omit painting. Zoom-bucket changes and restoration retain explicit regression coverage.
pen_cache.timing_limit: Separate hosted dev runners with diagnostic overhead and no GPU presentation. Timings establish neither controlled native speedup nor a source regression. Conversion remains about 40 ms; egui median varied from about 35 to 62 ms with unchanged product code.

first_paint.qualification: App first paint starts at zoom0.8 and contains only about4,000 vertices. It does not paint the whole scene. Scene construction/journaling and fixture saving occur outside that frame timing. The first whole-scene overview is measured separately after a camera fit; bounded warmups do not certify complete media residency.

mixed_cpu.memory_limit: Peak for the complete timed cargo/test invocation and its children, not a per-scale or per-phase allocation snapshot. It cannot identify scene retention, cache residency, a leak, or a native Windows memory requirement. Zero swaps and zero major faults are observed, not a claim of zero file reads.

interaction.middle_drag: Injected motion applies in the same sampled update, with less than 0.00004 screen pixels of numerical error; release leaves the camera unchanged.
interaction.wheel: After ten positive wheel events, ten synthetic no-event frames continue zoom by about 3.84%, then twenty frames are static. Tested source consumes egui smooth_scroll_delta and adds no second Slate easing layer.
interaction.interpretation: Heavy native frames amplifying the perceived wheel tail is an inference. Synthetic frame counts and CPU sums do not measure native event delivery or input-to-display latency.

limitations: Primary scenarios have only 10 samples, so p95 and p99 equal the observed maximum; these are descriptive smoke tails, not robust rare-event estimates.
All timings are optimized dev/test CPU on a hosted Linux runner. No Windows release or native speedup claim is supported.
No GPU upload, draw submission, compositor/vsync, delivered frames, hardware input/OS event queues, or input-to-photon latency is measured.
Model cards do not exercise live GL rendering, multiple model orbit, real Rhino assets or heavy real-world material/texture scenes.
Only24 distinct image sources are repeatedly placed. Unique 5,000-image pressure, large Downloads images and real cloud/network behavior are untested here.

Node positions, authored segment counts and camera fit change with scale. Doubling scene count is not a controlled doubling of visible triangles; zoom buckets, LOD, clipping, atlas activity and async worker timing can differ. Do not infer a universal complexity law from these two points.
No active per-sample cache probe in this workload; geometry counts cover all egui primitives, not exclusively pen paths. Hits/evictions/residency cannot be inferred from counts or RSS.
No assertion verifies every image/model preview or brush tile is ready, and no screenshots or export comparisons establish visual fidelity.
The test passing means scenario execution and invariants passed. The benchmark has no frame-budget assertion and clearly exceeds interactive budgets in overview.

historical_native_baselines.scope: Existing October 19 binary, not changed-source before/after validation.

brush5000.limit: Five observations do not establish a reliable p95.

mixed5000.limit: Motivated poster deduplication; the fix effect is not measured in a current-source native run.

unverified: Current-source native pan/zoom input-to-display latency and GPU presentation.
Visual continuity, capture/export parity and native first meaningful paint of the changed source.
Thousands of distinct image paths, live real-model viewports and long-session memory behavior.
local_execution_limit: Windows denied a generated rfd build helper and xtask. One authorized retry also failed. No security, dependency, profile, flag, cache or path workaround was used. A future native session requires permitted execution and appropriate UI ownership.
next_work: Run matched release native comparisons sequentially, recording frame tails, delivered input latency, cold/warm readiness, visual continuity and sustained memory.
